evidence.all_checks_scope: Reproducibility, fixed-scene integrity, resource/GL/nonwood controls, video decode/duration/frame counts, supplementary UV geometry and isolation/reference pipeline assertions. This is not a subjective visual or motion-shimmer approval, performance improvement, or application-wide test result.
evidence.heavy_status: All evidence captures, simulation fixture creation, encoding and full decoding are terminal. No evidence heavy process remains.

definitions.fresh: Fresh Chrome profile with server already running; machine/compiler caches not erased.
definitions.warm: Second navigation in the same tab/profile/server.
definitions.first_interaction: Native World button mouse press/release to two RAFs; no simulation action-success claim.
definitions.render: 40 synchronous draws plus 1pixel GPU readback; all raw samples. Separate 1sec RAF sample per camera.
definitions.memory: ps process-tree RSS; overlapping/shared totals are not unique memory or GPU VRAM.
definitions.physics: Frozen qpos/qvel/ctrl/time restored before initial serve; paused, no stepping or further state forcing.
definitions.video: Actual Chrome camera motion and timestamped raw JPEG frames; encoded after each capture, full decode verified separately.
definitions.controls: Supplementary material planes only after all real-scene timing/memory captures.
definitions.camera_comparison: Requested cameras identical. Orbit controls reproduce floating coordinates within1e-12m; literal equality separately retained; observed deltas below1e-15m.
definitions.actual_nonwood_controls: Full park_low includes visible wood table/bench and is expected to differ; retain whole-frame literal failure and pixel bbox. Three explicit concrete/grass crops are checked byte-exact across all4runs.

supplementary_terrain.scope: Supplementary real stairs/ramp, outside formal4scene statistics
supplementary_terrain.face_uv_pitch_definition: all6faces on all5wood boxes; two independent UV edges per face, expected1/1.2repeats per local-meter; tolerance1e-5 from float32 attributes

decoded_motion_sheets.definition: Actual before/after concatenated MP4 decode, three frames from each constituent scene; no generated or raw-JPEG substitutes.

evidence.candidate_status: V3 evaluated; coordinator final acceptance remains separate. Previous239check summary retained in v3-preceding/.

quality_findings.still_review: Coordinator accepted v3 fixed real-scene previews for formal validation: no comb-like stripe pattern, visible elongated object grain, restrained floor joints.
quality_findings.motion_metric_limitation: Proxy counts fixed-screen luminance reversals during camera strafe; no motion compensation, material mask or edge mask. Both matched cohorts regress reproducibly. This does not uniquely identify alias energy, and no cross-view pooled improvement is claimed.
quality_findings.motion_acceptance: Coordinator final motion acceptance remains separate. Isolation implicates floor color-map movement, including the floor background in the table camera; bounded2x same-source reference errors are lower in both predefined ROIs. No claim that temporal quality or shimmer improved.
quality_findings.performance: Mixed. Several views cost more, bench detail costs less. Fresh/warm navigation and RSS move in both directions. No overall speedup or memory-reduction claim.

attempts_and_limits: preview-v1-A1 failed before simulator/GPU startup because initial narrow helper snapshot omitted transitive combos import. Failed log retained; full scripts snapshot resolved it.
v1 runtime exact JS files were not snapshotted; runtime digest and actual previews retained. V1 removed stripes but left broad blotches/blank floor and was rejected.
v2 longest-bbox wood axis is verified on actual table/bench geometry; object grain contrast was judged too low. Runtime JS snapshot and previews retained.
v3 is the formal candidate. Source3JS snapshot, helper snapshots, all previews, failed literal summary and all raw samples remain retained.
Initial successful baseline wood-diagnostic trial is retained separately from matched final A/B diagnostics; final A/B share identical helper hashes and explicit restoration assertions.
Four orbit-control camera vectors differed at less than1e-15m; accepted camera comparison uses1e-12m, raw vectors and literal equality results retained.
Whole park_low contains visible wooden table/bench so its full PNG is not an unchanged-nonwood control. Changed6134pixels retained; three explicit concrete/grass crops are byte-exact across4runs.

This evidence does not execute the coordinator's subsequent application-wide412tests/framework/budget/smoke gates and does not establish single-action task success, a pristine-machine cold start, GPU VRAM, or other-platform behavior.

definitions.isolation: Actual scene material clones restored after each case; original camera/light/geometry/state. Floor color-off multiplies base linear color by requested approximate0.91, not an exact mean-match. Floor roughness-off uses0.53. Object color-off retains source shader's exact .575 mean multiplier; bump/roughness patches keep all other shader code.
definitions.reference: Same-source actual existing default-framebuffer canvas at1x1280x800 and2x2560x1600. Same camera projection/pose, outputSRGB/NeutralToneMapping/exposure/shadow settings and CSS. PNG read synchronously after render before default buffer can be discarded. BOX reduction in encoded outputRGB; comparison is canvas rendering, excludes HTML UI.
definitions.scope: 5camera positions0,.005,.01,.015,.02m per view. Per-frame resolution error and differences of those error fields, not cross-sourceRGB, motion-compensated alias energy, or a quality score to minimize at the expense of real detail.
definitions.linear_light_BOX: Decode actual high-res sRGB PNG to linearRGB with standard sRGB transfer, arithmetic2x2BOX, then compare to decoded lowPNG. Report unitRGB separately from PIL encoded-sRGB BOX8bit metrics.

limits: Isolation changes one channel; fixed0.91 floor-color removal is not exact mean calibration. Counts are correlation diagnostics, not independent alias energy.
Original fixed-screen reversal metric and its regression are preserved; table camera includes a moving floor background outside the table ROI.

1x/2x error and temporal residual differences measure same-source sampling consistency, not reprojected temporal alias energy or subjective quality. Real texture detail must not be flattened merely to reduce these values.
Original low_std_8bit is globalRGB standard deviation, not a spatial texture-contrast metric. This summary adds per-channel and luminance spatial statistics.
A narrow table back-edge strip of about1-2rows may remain inside the predefined table ROI. Spatial luminance statistics include illumination and are not isolated fibre contrast.
sampling_diagnostic.conclusion: Floor color-map contribution dominates the increased fixed-screen reversal count, including table-camera background. V3 has lower same-source spatial error and temporal residual-difference error than baseline within each predefined real-surface ROI; this supports sampling consistency, not an alias-free-motion claim.
